Citymaker.HikingTrail.Name: Hiking trail
Citymaker.Recipe.HikingTrail.Description: A trail that follows the land: contour paths and switchbacks on slopes, a trailhead with parking and a map board, rest spots, viewpoints and footbridges over water.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.landscape.Tooltip: Sets where the trail likes to run and what grows around it: forest, open meadow, along the ridge, down the canyon, or by the water.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.route.Tooltip: Loop back to the trailhead, a through trail to another entrance (or out and back to the far end), or up to the summit and down another way.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.maxGrade.Tooltip: Steepest climb the trail should take. Lower values follow the contours and add switchbacks on slopes.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.wander.Tooltip: How much the trail meanders on easy ground.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.restSpacing.Toolti: Distance between rest spots along the trail (bench facing the view, bin, picnic table). 0 = none.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.viewpoints.Tooltip: Viewing platforms with benches at the most prominent points along the trail.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.lookoutTower.Toolt: Puts a lookout tower (or shelter) at the best viewpoint.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.picnicTables.Toolt: A picnic table at every rest spot.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.waymarkers.Tooltip: Distance between signposts along the trail. 0 = none.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.trailheads.Tooltip: Car park, map board and bench at the main entrance, at every entrance, or none.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.parking.Tooltip: Marked car spaces at each trailhead (a gravel or asphalt pad beside the trail entry).
Citymaker.HikingTrail.mapBoard.Tooltip: A trail map or information board at the trailhead.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.bridges.Tooltip: Lets the trail cross water on footbridges. Off: the trail goes around water.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.treeDensity.Toolti: Trees per hectare (forest is 200 or more).
Citymaker.HikingTrail.trailClear.Tooltip: Distance kept free of trees on each side of the trail.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.clearings.Tooltip: Open clearings beside the trail, each with a bench. Camp and picnic features get their own.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.wornTrail.Tooltip: Paints worn ground along the trail (permanent).
Citymaker.HikingTrail.shapeTerrain.Toolt: Carves a gorge around the trail or raises a ridge under it, blended back to the ground at the outline (permanent). Auto: gorge for canyons, ridge for ridges.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.terrainDepth.Toolt: How deep the gorge is or how high the ridge rises, in metres.
Citymaker.HikingTrail.bridgeAsset.Toolti: Path used for footbridges over water (automatic = a pedestrian bridge).
Citymaker.HikingTrail.Issue.NoRoute: Hiking trail: no route fits inside the area (too narrow, blocked or under water).
Citymaker.AddOn.TrailCamp.Name: Backcountry camp
Citymaker.AddOn.TrailCamp.shelter.Toolti: A simple shelter at the edge of the camp.
